# Vehicle

Query target: `VEHICLE`. These are static capabilities; the live session decides which objects and operations are available. See [session semantics](../data_model.md) and [write behavior](../writable.md).

Shapes describe tensor dimensions; lanes describe the tuple width, not an extra dimension. Ordering is row-major unless stated otherwise. **CPU** means host memory; **scene device** means CPU on CPU/readback scenes or CUDA on DirectGPU; **CUDA** requires CUDA. Symbolic sizes come from the live group.

| Attribute | Access | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| [accelerator](#accelerator) | read/write | persistent accelerator input |
| [autoboxTimeSinceLastShift](#autoboxtimesincelastshift) | read | automatic-gearbox time since the last shift; zero without an autobox |
| [automaticTransmission](#automatictransmission) | read | automatic transmission enabled |
| [brake0](#brake0) | read/write | persistent brake-channel input |
| [brake1](#brake1) | read/write | persistent brake-channel input |
| [clutch](#clutch) | read | native clutch command state |
| [currentGear](#currentgear) | read | engaged gear |
| [engineRotationSpeed](#enginerotationspeed) | read | engine angular speed |
| [gearSwitchTime](#gearswitchtime) | read | elapsed time in current gear change; negative when no change is active |
| [requestedGear](#requestedgear) | write | persistent gear request (write-only) |
| [resetToRestState](#resettoreststate) | write | execute native rest reset (write-only) |
| [steer](#steer) | read/write | persistent steering input |
| [targetGear](#targetgear) | read | internal transmission target, distinct from the requested control |
| [thrust0](#thrust0) | write | persistent track thrust (write-only) |
| [thrust1](#thrust1) | write | persistent track thrust (write-only) |

## resetToRestState

`u8`; units: [dimensionless](units.md#dimensionless).

| Access | Layout | Memory |
|---|---|---|
| Write | fixed, shape [objects], 1 lanes | CPU |

**Write:** Every addressed chassis must have simulation enabled, including rows containing 0; values: 0 or 1; requires [Vehicle](#vehicle).

Runs a command; executes once. Visibility: commit.

A value of 0 leaves the row unchanged; 1 resets it. Other values reject the entire group before mutation.

## Conditions

### Vehicle

Vehicles are unavailable on DirectGPU. Controls require compatible drive/chassis state and finite accepted values; writes preflight the group before mutation. Telemetry may omit incompatible rows.
